sections.title: 一、完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，理解其大意，从 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Li Lei and Tom are good friends, although they are very different. Li Lei wants to be a [1] in the future because he is interested in law. Tom loves [2] and hopes to become a musician. Last Saturday, they decided to cook a meal together. They went to the supermarket to buy the ingredients. Tom picked up a bottle of tomato sauce, some [3] and a bag of flour. Li Lei found some vegetables. "We need to [4] the vegetables into small pieces," Li Lei said.

Back in the kitchen, Tom followed the [5] . First, he mixed the flour with water to make the dough (面团). Then, he spread the tomato sauce on it. Li Lei added the vegetables and cheese. After that, they put the pizza into the [6] and waited. Twenty minutes later, the pizza was ready. It looked and smelled wonderful. "What a [7] pizza!" Tom shouted. Li Lei smiled and said, "We did it together, although we are so different." This experience made them understand that [8] are not important in a friendship. What matters is that you are willing to [9] everything with your friend. Also, you should always [10] dreams.

questions.translation: 李磊未来想成为一名律师，因为他对法律很感兴趣。
questions.explanation: 根据后半句 'because he is interested in law'（因为他对法律感兴趣）可知，对法律感兴趣的人未来想成为一名律师，故选 lawyer。

questions.translation: 汤姆热爱音乐，并希望成为一名音乐家。
questions.explanation: 根据后半句 'and hopes to become a musician'（并希望能成为一名音乐家）可知，汤姆热爱的是音乐，故选 music。

questions.translation: 汤姆拿了一瓶番茄酱、一些奶酪和一袋面粉。
questions.explanation: 根据后文做披萨的食材清单 'added the vegetables and cheese' 以及前句 'buy the ingredients' 可知，此处购买的是食物原料奶酪，故选 cheese。

questions.translation: 我们需要把蔬菜切成小块。
questions.explanation: 搭配 '... into small pieces'（切成小块），cut ... into small pieces 为固定搭配，意为“把……切碎/切成小块”，故选 cut。

questions.translation: 回到厨房后，汤姆按照操作说明来做。
questions.explanation: 后文按照 'First... Then... After that...' 逐步进行制作，说明是遵循食谱的操作指南/说明，follow the instructions 为常用搭配，故选 instructions。

questions.translation: 之后，他们把披萨放进烤箱并等待。
questions.explanation: 制作披萨需要烘烤，结合常识和语境可知是放入烤箱（oven）中，故选 oven。

questions.translation: “多么美味的披萨啊！”汤姆大声喊道。
questions.explanation: 前句提到 'It looked and smelled wonderful.'（它看起来和闻起来棒极了），汤姆赞叹披萨非常美味，故选 delicious。

questions.translation: 这次经历让他们明白，差异在友谊中并不重要。
questions.explanation: 前文多次强调 'although they are very different' 和 'although we are so different'，说明两人性格爱好虽不同但仍是好友，因此差异（differences）并不影响友谊，故选 differences。

questions.translation: 重要的是你愿意和你的朋友分享一切。
questions.explanation: 搭配 '... everything with your friend'，share sth. with sb. 为固定短语，意为“与某人分享某事”，故选 share。

questions.translation: 而且，你应该始终坚持自己的梦想。
questions.explanation: 根据第一段李磊想当律师、汤姆想当音乐家，可知面对未来应当坚持（stick to）梦想，故选 'stick to (坚持)'。

sections.title: 二、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Food is a window to different cultures. When I studied in Thailand last year, I learned to cook Tom Yum Goong (冬阴功汤). The process taught me more than just cooking skills.

First, my host mom helped me prepare some ingredients- lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, and galangal. Haha! I'd never heard of them before. "Cooking is like painting," she said. "You must balance different flavors(味道)-sour, sweet, salty, and spicy."

Next, we added the shrimp (虾) and poured coconut milk in. The soup was boiling and filled the kitchen with a wonderful smell. When it was ready, we ate it with sticky rice. The mixture of flavors danced on my tongue.

My host family explained that Tom Yum Goong is more than a dish. It's a symbol of Thai <u>hospitality</u>. They cook it for guests to show warmth and respect. Through this experience, I realized that every culture expresses its stories and values through food.

Now I cook Tom Yum Goong for my family in China. It helps me think of my time in Thailand and share Thai culture with others. Food truly connects people across borders (国界).

Exploring foreign food allows us to discover new worlds. Even simple dishes can tell rich cultural stories. You don't always need to travel far-try a new restaurant in your city. The flavors might be different, but the feelings they create are common. Food builds bridges between people and nations. That's the magic of cooking tradition.

questions.prompt: Who taught the writer to cook Tom Yum Goong?
questions.translation: 谁教作者做冬阴功汤的？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段第一句 'First, my host mom helped me prepare some ingredients...' 以及上下文可知，是寄宿家庭的妈妈（host mom）教作者做冬阴功汤的，故选 'Her host mom.'。

questions.prompt: Why does the writer still cook Tom Yum Goong in China now?
options: Because it is more delicious than Chinese food.
Because her family in China cannot cook it.
Because it is the only dish she learned how to cook.
Because it reminds her of Thailand and helps share its culture.
questions.translation: 为什么作者现在在中国仍然会做冬阴功汤？
questions.explanation: 根据第五段中 'It helps me think of my time in Thailand and share Thai culture with others.' 可知，这让她想起在泰国的时光，并能与他人分享泰国文化，故选 'Because it reminds her of Thailand and helps share its culture.'。

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word "<u>hospitality</u>" probably mean?
options: The friendly and warm welcome to guests.
questions.translation: 画线单词“hospitality”最可能是什么意思？
questions.explanation: 根据第四段后一句 'They cook it for guests to show warmth and respect.'（他们为客人做这道菜以表达热情和尊重）可知，hospitality 指对客人的热情好客与欢迎，故选 'The friendly and warm welcome to guests.'。

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose (目的) of the text?
options: To teach readers how to cook Tom Yum Goong.
To compare Chinese food with Thai food.
To show that food can connect different cultures.
To explain why the writer studied in Thailand.
questions.translation: 本文的主要目的是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章首句提出 'Food is a window to different cultures.'，并在后文多次阐述 'Food truly connects people across borders.' 以及 'Food builds bridges between people and nations.'，说明食物是连接不同文化的桥梁，故选 'To show that food can connect different cultures.'。

sections.title: 二、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
The Green Rice Ball, known as "aiban"(艾粄) in southern China, is a sweet traditional Chinese snack. It's mainly eaten on the Qingming Festival. It's a popular food in the Hakka area. Let's learn to make "aiban".

**Materials we need:** wormwood leaves (艾叶), glutinous rice flour (糯米粉), sugar, water, and red bean filling.

**Making procedure:**

- ① Wash the wormwood leaves carefully.
- ② Boil them in hot water for about 10 minutes.
- ③ Put them into the blender and beat them.
- ④ Mix the glutinous rice flour with the wormwood juice. Add water and sugar to make a dough.
- ⑤ Divide the dough into small balls.
- ⑥ Add some red bean filling in the middle and wrap(包) it up like a little ball.
- ⑦ Steam the "aiban" in a steamer for about 15 minutes.

Wormwood is a herb that is good for our health. It can help us stay strong and out of sickness. And the glutinous rice flour gives us energy, which is important for growing teenagers like us. Why not go and make "aiban" now?

options: It's popular in the Hakka area.
It's the traditional food in northern China.
questions.translation: 关于“艾粄”，下列哪项是正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段中 'It's a popular food in the Hakka area.' 可知，艾粄在客家地区很受欢迎，故选 'It\'s popular in the Hakka area.'。

questions.prompt: How many types of things should you prepare according to the text?
questions.translation: 根据短文，你应该准备多少种材料？
questions.explanation: 根据 **Materials we need** 一栏列出的材料：1. wormwood leaves (艾叶), 2. glutinous rice flour (糯米粉), 3. sugar, 4. water, 5. red bean filling，总共5种材料，故选 Five。

questions.prompt: We need to boil the wormwood leaves for about ______.
questions.translation: 我们需要把艾叶煮大约 ______。
questions.explanation: 根据步骤② 'Boil them in hot water for about 10 minutes.' 可知，煮艾叶需要大约10分钟，故选 '10 minutes'。

questions.prompt:
Which of the following is the correct order of making the snack?

① Beat them and then mix with the glutinous rice flour, water and sugar.
② Wash the wormwood leaves and boil them.
③ Divide the dough into small balls and wrap the red bean filling in the ball.
④ Steam the "aiban" in a steamer.
questions.translation: 制作该小吃的正确顺序是以下哪一项？
questions.explanation: 按照制作步骤：首先是清洗并煮艾叶（②），接着打碎并与糯米粉、水、糖混合揉面（①），然后分成小面团包入红豆馅（③），最后放入蒸锅蒸熟（④），正确顺序为 ②→①→③→④，故选 '②→①→③→④'。

questions.prompt: What kind of text is the passage?
questions.translation: 这篇文章属于什么类型的文本？
questions.explanation: 文章详细列出了制作艾粄所需的材料和制作步骤，是一篇烹饪制作指南（A cooking guide），故选 'A cooking guide.'。

sections.title: 三、阅读还原
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从短文后的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。选项中有一项为多余选项。
sections.passage:
# When Milk Skin (奶皮子) Meets Tanghulu

Most people know about tanghulu. It is a common street snack in North China. You often see it in winter. It is made of red hawthorn (山楂) covered with shiny, hard sugar. But food is always changing. [1]

What makes it different? [2] People put these thin milk skins on a long stick and add some fruit. Then, they dip the stick into hot sugar water (糖水). After that, they must let it get cold very quickly. This makes the sugar become hard. So, you get a snack that is soft and milky inside but sweet and hard outside.

Why do young people love it so much? First, the taste is new and interesting. It is not sour like fruit tanghulu. [3] Second, it looks very pretty and is perfect for taking pictures to share online. On apps, many people post photos about it. This makes everyone want to try it.

But is it good for you? We should think about this. The milk skin has protein (蛋白质), which is good. [4] So, it is okay to eat sometimes, but not too often. A balanced diet (饮食) is always the best.

This new snack is more than just food. [5] It takes a special ingredient, the milk skin, and uses a northern way of making tanghulu. This creative mix makes our food culture more fun and exciting for everyone!
wordbank: However, the sugar outside has a lot of calories (卡路里).
It shows how food ideas can travel and mix.
This snack mixes fruit with something called milk skins which come from milk.
Now, there is a new and popular kind: Milk Skin Tanghulu!
The taste is creamy and sweet, and the hard sugar feels good when you eat it.
They can make it at home with their families, which is also a fun activity.

questions.translation: 现在，有一种流行的新品种：奶皮子糖葫芦！
questions.explanation: 前文提到传统的山楂糖葫芦，以及“但美食总是在变化”，后文全篇都在介绍“奶皮子糖葫芦”，故选 'Now, there is a new and popular kind: Milk Skin Tanghulu!'。

questions.translation: 这种小吃将水果与一种来自牛奶的叫做奶皮子的东西混合在一起。
questions.explanation: 前句提问 'What makes it different?'（是什么让它与众不同？），后文解释将奶皮子串在竹签上并加入水果，故选 'This snack mixes fruit with something called milk skins which come from milk.' 引出奶皮子与水果的搭配。

questions.translation: 味道香浓甜美，吃的时候硬糖的口感也很好。
questions.explanation: 本段分析为什么年轻人如此喜欢它。前一句提到口味新颖有趣且不像传统水果糖葫芦那么酸，承接描述其奶香和甜美的口感，故选 'The taste is creamy and sweet, and the hard sugar feels good when you eat it.'。

questions.translation: 然而，外面的糖含有很高的卡路里。
questions.explanation: 前句提到奶皮子含有蛋白质（有益健康），后句提出不能吃太频繁。转折词 However 引出糖分高热量大的事实，故选 'However, the sugar outside has a lot of calories (卡路里).'。

questions.translation: 它展示了美食创意是如何传播与融合的。
questions.explanation: 前句指出这种新小吃不仅仅是食物，后文阐述其结合了特产奶皮子与北方传统的糖葫芦做法，说明美食创意的传播与融合，故选 'It shows how food ideas can travel and mix.'。

sections.title: 四、短文填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，用方框中所给词的适当形式填空。每词限用一次。
sections.passage:
Noodles are my favourite food. Whenever I see or eat them, they always bring back sweet [1] of my dear grandma.

When I was young, my grandma always cooked [2] tomato and egg noodles for me. It had a special smell with my grandma's sweetness. The noodles were soft, [3] the tomatoes were fresh. I liked the sweet taste of the tomatoes. While eating the noodles, I shared the stories at school [4] her.

Cooking noodles was really [5] for her. First, she heated water in a pot until it boiled. Then, she cut some carrots and cabbages into small [6] . Next, she put the noodles into the [7] water. After a few minutes, she took the noodles out and put them in a bowl. Then, she [8] chicken soup or beef soup over the noodles. After that, she added a little oil to make [9] taste better. Then she put the vegetables in the bowl, mixed the vegetables and noodles together. [10] , we ate the noodles. Yummy!

Every time I eat noodles, I think of my grandma and the pleasant times. Noodles are not just food. They are full of love.

questions.translation: 它们总能勾起我对亲爱的奶奶的甜蜜回忆。
questions.explanation: bring back memories of... 为常用表达，意为“勾起关于……的回忆”，名词 memory 用复数形式 memories，故填 memories。

questions.translation: 奶奶总是为我煮美味的西红柿鸡蛋面。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词短语 tomato and egg noodles，应用形容词 delicious 表示“美味的”，故填 delicious。

questions.translation: 面条很软，西红柿很新鲜。
questions.explanation: 连接前后两个并列的分句 'The noodles were soft' 和 'the tomatoes were fresh'，表示并列关系，故填 and。

questions.translation: 在吃面条的时候，我和她分享在学校的故事。
questions.explanation: share sth. with sb. 为固定搭配，意为“与某人分享某事”，介词用 with，故填 with。

questions.translation: 煮面条对她来说真的很简单。
questions.explanation: 在系动词 was 后面作表语，应用形容词 simple，表示“简单的”，故填 simple。

questions.translation: 然后，她把一些胡萝卜和卷心菜切成小块。
questions.explanation: cut ... into small pieces 为固定搭配，意为“切成小块”，piece 用复数形式 pieces，故填 pieces。

questions.translation: 接着，她把面条放入沸水中。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词 water，表示“沸腾的水/开水”，使用现在分词 boiling 作定语，故填 boiling。

questions.translation: 然后，她把鸡汤或牛肉汤浇在面条上。
questions.explanation: 描述过去发生的事情，句子用一般过去时，动词 pour 的过去式为 poured，故填 poured。

questions.translation: 在那之后，她加了一点油让它们尝起来更香。
questions.explanation: make sb./sth. do sth.，此处指代前面的面条（noodles），作 make 的宾语，应用 they 的宾格形式 them，故填 them。

questions.translation: 最后，我们吃了面条。
questions.explanation: 承接前文做面条的步骤 'First... Then... Next... Then... After that... Then...'，表示“最后”，应用副词 finally，句首首字母需大写，故填 Finally。
